50720746.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to BRD2-BD1 by SPR spectroscopy

original_paragraph.Table 1 footnote: Dissociation constants between each compound except for BIC1 and bromodomains were measured by isothermal titration calorimetry while those of BIC1 was measured by SPR spectroscopy. The ability of compounds to displace acetylated histone peptides from bromodomains was measured by either a luminescence proximity homogenous assay (JQ1) or FRET assays (I-BET and GW841819).
